subject: Post-demo: stakeholder trajectory, procurement checkpoints, and PO routing
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Gomez <rachel.gomez@novaterra.com>, Tom Hayes <t.hayes@novaterra.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: stakeholder trajectory, procurement checkpoints, and PO routing

Thanks again for taking the time to walk through the pilot flow this morning — appreciated the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and asks so we have a working list for the procurement track: 

1) Economic buyer and approval lane: can you confirm who will sign/approve the SOW and who owns budget? (We heard VP Product might be involved.)
2) Legal/security checklist: which artifacts does legal need up front (SOC2, DPA, vendor questionnaire)?
3) Procurement steps: is a PO required for pilots? If yes, what is the typical lead time and invoice routing address?
4) Timeline constraints: any hard cutoffs for billing periods or fiscal constraints we should know about?

Next steps from our side: Aditya will draft a short mutual action plan and an updated SOW reflecting the pilot scope and pricing cadence. Marissa, copying you to confirm preferred billing/contact details for invoicing once we have PO info.

Attachments: Procurement_Roster_Template.xlsx (blank roster for your team to fill), Novaterra_Master_SOW_v1.pdf (initial SOW we demoed).

Would you be available for a 30-min procurement sync next week (Wed/Thu)?

Best,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

From: Rachel Gomez <rachel.gomez@novaterra.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hayes <t.hayes@novaterra.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: stakeholder trajectory, procurement checkpoints, and PO routing

Thanks, Lauren — great recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Economic buyer: Olivia Martinez (VP Product) will own budget approval; she usually signs off after legal sign-off. I can introduce you to Olivia this week if helpful.
- Legal/security: our legal team will need SOC 2 Type II and our standard DPA. I've attached the vendor setup requirements doc (procurement keeps this as the checklist).
- Procurement: we do require a PO for any work over $10k. Typical lead time is 7-10 business days after receipt of the signed SOW + vendor onboarding packet. Invoices should be emailed to payables@novaterra.com and cc procurement@novaterra.com.
- Invoice details: our AP team needs the PO number on the invoice and the vendor EIN in the header — I'll paste the billing block below in a follow up from procurement.

I'm attaching the vendor_setup_requirements.pdf for reference. Wed/Thu next week both look OK for a sync; Wed afternoon would work best for me.

Regards,
Rachel Gomez
Head of Platform Partnerships
Novaterra Health
rachel.gomez@novaterra.com
[Attachment: vendor_setup_requirements.pdf (PDF, 312 KB)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Appreciate the quick responses, Rachel — super helpful. Notes / proposed action items: 

- Lauren: if you can intro Olivia, we can add her to the MAP and keep approvals visible.
- I will update the SOW to call out the pilot deliverables, acceptance criteria, and include a short payment schedule that supports a PO-driven invoice (net-45 by default unless you require otherwise). Draft will be uploaded to the HubSpot deal (D-34928) and I'll share a link.
- Marissa, please confirm Redwood's billing information and EIN to include on the sample invoice.
- Procurement working session: propose Wed 6/23, 11:00 AM PT — 30 minutes to run through onboarding packet, SOC2 evidence handoff, and invoice formatting.

Link to deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/34928
Draft SOW attached (v0.2) — this is focused on the 6-week pilot with targeted latency and logging SLAs.

Thanks — will follow up with the updated SOW by EOD Tue.

— Aditya

From: Tom Hayes <t.hayes@novaterra.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: stakeholder trajectory, procurement checkpoints, and PO routing

Hi all — I'm on the procurement side and looped in to confirm our operational requirements so you can get set up without surprises. Short answers: 

- PO: required for engagements over $10k. We issue net-45 by default.
- Invoice routing: send invoices to payables@novaterra.com and include PO# and vendor EIN. Copy procurement@novaterra.com.
- Required evidence before onboarding: current SOC 2 Type II report, certificate of insurance (general liability + cyber), W9 (or equivalent), and vendor bank details for ACH.
- Billing block for invoices:
  Novaterra Health, Inc.
  Attn: Accounts Payable
  410 Emerson Ave, Suite 320
  San Mateo, CA 94401
  EIN: 94-1234567

If you can provide SOC2 and COI up front (we can accept a secure link to a Drive folder), we can queue the vendor for intake and issue a PO within ~7 business days after the paperwork + signed SOW.

If you want, I can send the official vendor intake form and a DocuSign envelope for the SOW signature once we have the final PDF.

Thanks,
Tom Hayes
Procurement Manager
Novaterra Health
t.hayes@novaterra.com | +1 (650) 555-0976
